verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a distributed law firm offering legal services such as fintech regulatory counsel, venture financings, IP and privacy work. It is not a software product, so user-configurable background automations are a category error for this kind of offering. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any automation or agent tooling, and probes found no API or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
